name: Kuwagata Hanza
source: Born and raised in the poverty-striken Z district. Became acquainted with Kiriku when they were young. Works in a factory, but also has a band together with his friends as a hobby. Although he keeps a reasonable distance from people, he has many connections and friends. A bit afraid to cooperate with Kiriku's runaway plan.
